headline: CoreX and Alchemy Global Networks Announce Strategic Partnership to Deliver Autonomous Industrial Security and Risk Management
summary: RADNOR, Pa., August 05, 2026--CoreX, an Elite ServiceNow Partner specializing in Operational Technology (OT) management, industrial security, and enterprise workflow automation across the United States, Latin America, and Europe, today announced a strategic partnership with Alchemy Global Networks (AGN), a longtime partner of Armis to deliver an integrated industrial security and risk management solution.

headline: Freshworks (FRSH) Appoints Ryan Manning To Unify Product And Technology
summary: Freshworks has appointed Ryan Manning as Chief Product and Technology Officer, taking charge of both product and technology strategy. The move is aimed at sharpening the company’s focus on mid market and enterprise customers. Manning brings previous leadership experience from ServiceNow and BMC Helix. Freshworks, traded as NasdaqGS:FRSH, is drawing fresh attention with this leadership change at a time when the stock trades around $12.04. The shares are up 7.7% over the past week and 16.4%...
